description: This file is a shell script that manages the configuration and control of a PPTP VPN WAN connection. It includes functions for firewall setup, bringing the WAN interface up or down, and reacting to link and state changes. The script leverages system configuration and sysevent utilities to manage the PPTP VPN interface.

methods.name: unregister_firewall_hooks
methods.description: Removes existing firewall rules for PPTP by resetting sysevent variables.

methods.name: register_firewall_hooks
methods.description: Sets up firewall rules to allow PPTP traffic through the wan interface.

methods.name: prepare_pptp
methods.description: Configures the PPTP client, including creating the peers file with connection parameters.

methods.name: bring_wan_down
methods.description: Brings down the PPTP WAN interface, disables ip forwarding, unregisters firewall rules, and updates system states.

methods.name: bring_wan_up
methods.description: Sets up the PPTP WAN interface, applies firewall rules, and prepares the connection if the protocol is PPTP.
